title: ToolHop: A Query-Driven Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Multi-Hop Tool Use
authors_zh: Junjie Ye, Zhengyin Du, Xuesong Yao, Weijian Lin, Yufei Xu, Zehui Chen, Zaiyuan Wang, Sining Zhu, Zhiheng Xi, Siyu Yuan, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang, Jiecao Chen
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** A verifiable multi-hop tool-use benchmark with 995 queries and 3,912 local tools.
995 个查询与 3,912 个本地工具构成可验证的多跳工具使用 benchmark。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing tool-use evaluations often generate questions from a small set of fixed APIs, producing weak inter-tool dependencies, unverifiable answers, or remote services that cannot be reproduced. Correctly invoking one function does not establish that a model can identify multi-hop information needs, select a sequence of tools, and integrate intermediate results.

ToolHop constructs the required tool chain backward from user queries and jointly creates tools, documentation, code, and answers for local execution. It turns multi-hop tool use into a reproducible, automatically scored benchmark that also supports analysis of calling strategies.

现有工具调用评测常由少量固定 API 出发生成问题，容易产生工具之间缺少真实依赖、答案难核验或远程服务不可复现等问题。模型即使正确调用单个函数，也未必能识别多跳信息需求、选择连续工具并整合中间结果。

ToolHop 从用户查询反向构造所需工具链，将工具、文档、代码和答案共同生成并本地化执行，目标是把多跳工具使用变成可复跑、可自动判分且能分析调用策略的 benchmark。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ToolHop releases 995 user queries and 3,912 associated tools, covering multi-hop problems that require sequential, parallel, or combined calls. Each tool has natural-language documentation, an executable implementation, and structured outputs; queries include canonical answers and detailed feedback. The data object is a query–candidate tool set–calling process–final answer record, primarily for evaluating tool selection, argument generation, result aggregation, and end-to-end success rather than serving as a ready-made agent-trajectory training set.
ToolHop 发布 995 个用户查询及 3,912 个关联工具，覆盖需要连续、并行或组合调用的多跳问题。每个工具具有自然语言说明、可执行实现和结构化返回，查询附有标准答案及详细反馈。数据对象是“查询—候选工具集合—调用过程—最终答案”，主要用于工具选择、参数生成、结果聚合与端到端成功率评测，而不是现成的 agent 训练轨迹集。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Create queries: The authors first design natural-language questions requiring multiple facts or computations and specify a verifiable final answer.
  1. Build tools backward: Tools and their input-output interfaces are designed from query dependencies, followed by locally executable code so that meaningful multi-hop relations exist.
  1. Refine documentation and check: Tool descriptions, argument constraints, and return values are revised; reference call chains are executed and final answers verified. Non-executable or non-unique cases are removed.
  1. Run unified evaluation: Models receive the query and candidate tools, execute calls to obtain intermediate results, and are scored against the canonical answer while selection and invocation errors are logged.

1. 提出查询： 作者先构造需要多个事实或计算结果才能回答的自然语言查询，并明确最终可验证答案。
  1. 反向创建工具： 根据查询依赖设计局部工具及其输入输出，再生成可本地运行的代码，保证工具之间存在有意义的多跳关系。
  1. 完善文档与检查： 对工具描述、参数约束和返回值进行修订，执行参考调用链并核对最终答案；无法运行或答案不唯一的实例被删除。
  1. 统一评测： 模型获得查询与候选工具，通过真实执行产生中间结果，最终答案与标准答案比较，同时记录工具选择和调用错误。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper evaluates 14 models from five model families on the same 995 queries. The strongest model, GPT-4o, reaches only 49.04% final-answer accuracy, and model families exhibit distinct tool-selection and calling strategies. Released local tools, data, and execution scripts permit per-item reproduction, showing both benchmark discrimination and whether failure arises from tool choice, arguments, or result integration. A correct canonical answer, however, does not imply that only one valid call path exists.
论文在同一 995 个查询上评测 14 个模型，覆盖五个模型家族。最佳模型 GPT-4o 的最终答案准确率仅为 49.04%，不同模型家族还呈现明显不同的工具选择与调用策略。公开的本地工具、数据和执行脚本允许逐题复跑，因此结果不仅说明任务有区分度，也能定位失败发生在选错工具、参数错误还是结果整合阶段；但标准答案正确并不等于调用路径唯一。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier tool benchmarks commonly sample functions from an existing API list and then generate requests, making dependencies potentially superficial. ToolHop changes the construction direction through query-driven construction: it fixes a genuine question and answer requirement first, then creates the supporting tools, documentation, and implementations to guarantee multi-hop necessity and local executability. The novelty lies in jointly designing queries, tools, and the verifier rather than proposing a new agent.
以往工具 benchmark 多从已有 API 列表采样函数后再生成请求，工具依赖可能是表面拼接。ToolHop 的核心变化是采用 query-driven construction：先固定真实问题及答案需求，再生成支持该问题的工具、文档和实现，从数据构建阶段保证多跳必要性与本地可执行性。新意不在提出新的 agent，而在查询、工具和 verifier 的联合设计。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Synthetic boundary: Queries and tools are produced by a construction pipeline and do not fully represent real API permissions, latency, and failure modes; deployment requires tests with actual services.
  1. Answer-level scoring: Final-answer matching can hide inefficient or accidentally correct call chains. Call count, invalid calls, and intermediate evidence should also be reported.
  1. Scale and contamination: The 995 items support diagnosis but cannot cover all domains, and public release creates training-leakage risk. Long-term evaluation needs newly generated or hidden items.

1. 合成边界： 查询和工具由构造流程生成，不能完全代表真实 API 的权限、延迟和错误模式；部署前需在真实工具上补测。
  1. 答案级判分： 最终答案匹配可能掩盖低效或偶然正确的调用链；应同时报告调用数、无效调用和中间证据。
  1. 规模与污染： 995 题适合诊断但不足以覆盖全部领域，且公开后可能进入训练语料；持续评测需生成新题或保留隐藏集。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Tool-agent evaluation: Use the official local tools to compare models or planning scaffolds on end-to-end accuracy and classify errors in selection, arguments, and aggregation.
  1. Trajectory extension: Execute reference chains or collect failure–feedback–repair traces for SFT or RL, while keeping the original test set isolated from training.
  1. Retrieval ablation: Hold the model fixed and vary documentation length, candidate-tool count, and retrieval modules to determine whether gains come from tool discovery rather than answer memorization.

1. 工具 agent 评测： 使用官方本地工具比较不同模型或 planning scaffold 的端到端准确率，并按工具选择、参数与聚合错误分类。
  1. 轨迹训练扩展： 可运行参考链或采集模型失败—反馈—修正轨迹，形成 SFT/RL 数据，但应将原始测试集与训练集隔离。
  1. 检索消融： 固定模型，改变工具文档长度、候选工具数量与检索模块，检查收益是否来自更好的工具发现，而不是答案记忆。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: A verifiable multi-hop tool-use benchmark with 995 queries and 3,912 local tools.
  1. Method hook: Writing the query and answer requirements first, then generating tools, documentation, and code backward, is the key to meaningful dependencies.
  1. Data hook: Queries, tool implementations, canonical answers, and execution resources are released mainly for evaluation rather than direct training.
  1. Evidence anchor: GPT-4o reaches only 49.04% among 14 models, showing that end-to-end tool reasoning remains difficult.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits tool-selection and call-chain diagnosis, provided public-item leakage and real-API failures are separately addressed.

1. 一句话定位： 995 个查询与 3,912 个本地工具构成可验证的多跳工具使用 benchmark。
  1. 方法抓手： 先写查询和答案需求，再反向生成工具、文档与代码，是保证多跳依赖的关键。
  1. 数据抓手： 开放查询、工具实现、标准答案和执行资源，主要用于评测而非直接训练。
  1. 证据锚点： 14 个模型中 GPT-4o 仅达 49.04%，说明端到端工具推理仍困难。
  1. 复用决定： 适合工具选择与调用链诊断；复用前需防止公开题泄漏并补充真实 API 故障。
